historical_result.preceding_snapshot: Step 3 listed the Edit profile link after opening the account menu; step 4 timed out waiting for the :visible selector.

diagnostic_contract.action_scope: frozen actions 1-3, then read-only link geometry at 0, 2 and 5 seconds; no Edit profile click or profile mutation

reviewed_cause.mechanism_zh: 原轨迹打开 GitLab 账号菜单后，快照列出 Edit profile 链接，随后的 :visible 点击却超时。相同冻结前缀下，官方 Moli 1.1.6 中链接存在、样式可见、页面加载完成，但链接及父容器的矩形持续五秒为零；固定候选中两者均为 238×32。账号菜单更新后的布局几何未刷新，使依赖几何的可见性筛选排除了目标；与 #418 共享同一故障机制。
reviewed_cause.mechanism_en: After the original GitLab account menu opened, the snapshot listed Edit profile, but the following :visible click timed out. With the same frozen prefix, official Moli 1.1.6 had the link, visible computed style and a complete page, yet link and parent rectangles stayed zero for five seconds; the fixed candidate gave both a 238×32 rectangle. Geometry was not refreshed after the account-menu update, excluding the link from geometry-dependent visibility matching. This shares the mechanism observed in task 418.

scope_limit: Read-only same-page 1.1.6-versus-fixed geometry evidence; no profile update, formal 1.1.3 post-fix rerun, repeated-flake estimate, or commit-level bisect. The historical official score remains unchanged.
